model_output.verdict: Your move from Accounts Payable Clerk to Staff Accountant at Rivermark Building Supply is clear. I'd hesitate to move this forward because the accounting work reads mostly as duties, with little to show how much you handle or what changed.
write_up: This is a common pattern: your resume lists the accounting duties, but gives a recruiter little to distinguish your work from another Staff Accountant's. The move from accounts payable into the Staff Accountant role is clear; what you handle within that role needs more detail to stand out in a pile.

The journal entries and account reconciliations line is the best starting model because it names two things you prepare, rather than just saying you're responsible for a process. Your Experience is already above Education, and the dates make your progression at Rivermark easy to follow. A little context about the business would help a stranger understand the setting.

Let's start with month-end close. Name the tasks you handle and then add details to the reconciliations, audit and fixed asset work. Use numbers where you can confirm them, but a named account, asset type or audit deliverable can also show what the job involves.

fit.why: Your headline and current role both name Staff Accountant, with work in close, reconciliations, audit and fixed assets.
fit.level: mid-level, current Staff Accountant role following an Accounts Payable Clerk role
fit.note: Your experience points toward staff accounting roles that combine close and account reconciliation with other accounting duties. The earlier accounts payable work adds context to that path.
